description: This source file implements a QUIC client interop testing tool that performs various protocol feature tests, including version negotiation, handshake, stream data exchange, TLS resumption, 0-RTT, retries, HTTP/3, key updates, and server rebinding. It constructs and sends HTTP/2 requests over QUIC, manages connection features, and reports server support for different features.

classes.name: QuicClientInteropRunner
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of QUIC protocol feature tests, including resumption, request attempts, and feature detection, by interacting with QuicDefaultClient instances.

methods.name: AttemptResumption
methods.description: Attempts to resume a session with the server and records features like resumption and 0-RTT if successful.

methods.name: AttemptRequest
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive QUIC connection and request cycle, testing version negotiation, handshake, HTTP/3, key updates, rebinding, and connection closure, recording supported features.

methods.name: ConstructHeaderBlock
methods.description: Constructs HTTP/2 headers for a GET request to the specified authority.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request using the client and records features like stream data exchange.
